title: ContingentTransfer
description: Specifies a transfer created from a trade contingent upon a specific, uncertain event on a contract

quantity.description: Represents the amount of the asset to be transferred. The cashflow amount is always a positive number, as the cashflow direction is implied by the payer/receiver attribute.

asset.description: Represents the object that is subject to the transfer, it could be an asset or a reference.

settlementDate.description: Represents the date on which the transfer to due.

paymentDiscounting.description: FpML specifies the FpML PaymentDiscounting.model group for representing the discounting elements that can be associated with a payment.

identifier.description: Represents a unique reference to the transfer.

payerReceiver.description: Represents the parties to the transfer and their role.

transferType.description: Specifies the type of contingent transfer.

payoutReference.description: Represents the origin to the transfer as a reference for lineage purposes, whether it originated from trade level settlement terms or from payment terms on an economic payout.

corporateActionTransferType.description: A transfer corresponding to a corporate action event
